# Southeast Arbor Care

> Family-owned tree service in Pasadena, Texas, since 1991. Tree removal, trimming and pruning, stump grinding, storm and emergency work, lot clearing, and tree health care across Pasadena, Deer Park, La Porte, Clear Lake and Webster, Baytown and southeast Houston. Phone (713) 472-1488, Monday to Saturday 8 AM to 6 PM; storm and emergency calls are answered after hours. Shop at 3322 Thornwood Dr, Pasadena, TX 77503. Estimates are free and nothing is charged until the work is finished.

## Services

- [Tree Removal](https://southeastarbor.com/services/tree-removal): full takedowns in tight yards, over roofs and fences, rigged down piece by piece
- [Trimming & Pruning](https://southeastarbor.com/services/tree-trimming-and-pruning): crown thinning, deadwood, and clearance from roofs and power drops
- [Stump Grinding](https://southeastarbor.com/services/stump-grinding): ground six to ten inches below grade
- [Storm & Emergency](https://southeastarbor.com/services/storm-and-emergency): split leaders, hangers and trees on a roof, answered after hours
- [Lot Clearing](https://southeastarbor.com/services/lot-clearing): residential and commercial lots cleared to grade
- [Tree Health & Feeding](https://southeastarbor.com/services/tree-health-and-feeding): deep-root fertilization, disease and pest inspection, cabling and bracing
